title: Optimal Extensions of Cross-Sections: Sphere Packings in Dimensions 38 to 43
summary: We improve the best known sphere packings in every dimension from $38$ to $43$. Our packings in dimensions $38$ to $42$ come from one chain of cross-sections of the extremal even unimodular lattice $P_{48p}$, $\sqrt3E_6 \subset \sqrt3E_7 \subset \sqrt3E_8 \subset K_9 \subset K_{10}$, whose first three members are cut from the fixed lattice $\sqrt3(E_8 \perp E_8)$ of an order-three automorphism; their orthogonal complements are lattice packings and set the records in dimensions $42$ down to $38$.
